mt_status_on: Enabled — visitors see the maintenance page
mt_status_off: Disabled — the site is live as normal
mt_message_help: You stay able to browse the site normally while logged in as admin. Everyone else sees this message instead, with an HTTP 503 status.
mt_title_help: Shown above the message and in the browser tab. Leave empty to use the default.
mt_logo_help: Replaces the default icon. Any image size works — it is automatically scaled down to fit.
